data.name: ProductionFactoryRequiresEnhancedSyntax_Title
data.value: API requires applying 'Farkle.Builder.UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute'

data.name: ProductionFactoryRequiresEnhancedSyntax_MessageFormat
data.value: Using class 'Farkle.Builder.Production' requires applying 'Farkle.Builder.UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute'

data.name: ProductionFactoryRequiresEnhancedSyntax_Description
data.value: To ensure high performance for the production factory source generator, using a method in the 'Farkle.Builder.Production' class requires applying 'UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute'.

data.value: Invalid usage of 'Farkle.Builder.Production' factory method

data.name: ProductionFactoryUnsupportedType_MessageFormat
data.value: Argument {0}: cannot convert from '{1}' to 'string' or 'Farkle.Builder.IGrammarSymbol'

data.name: ProductionFactoryUnsupportedType_Description
data.value: Production factory methods only support arguments of type 'string' or 'Farkle.Builder.IGrammarSymbol'.

data.name: ProductionFactoryTooManyTypedSymbols_MessageFormat
data.value: Production factory method cannot contain more than {0} arguments of type 'Farkle.Builder.IGrammarSymbol<T>'

data.name: UseEnhancedSyntaxAttributeUnnecessary_Description
data.value: The 'UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute' attribute is unnecessary on this type or member, as no code in it requires its use.

data.name: SwitchToProductionFactories_Title
data.value: Use 'Production.Create' to create production builder

data.name: SwitchToProductionFactories_MessageFormat
data.value: Use 'Production.Create' instead of 'Append'/'Extend' methods to create production builder

data.name: SwitchToProductionFactories_Description
data.value: Instead of chaining calls to 'Append' and 'Extend' methods to create a production builder, using 'Production.Create' results in more readable and performant code.

data.name: CannotInferProductionFactoryParameters_Title
data.value: Cannot infer types of production factory arguments

data.name: CannotInferProductionFactoryParameters_MessageFormat
data.value: Cannot infer type of production factory arguments. Consider explicitly specifying the types of variables involved in the factory call.

data.name: CannotInferProductionFactoryParameters_Description
data.value: The production factory source generator failed to infer the type of some of the arguments. You can resolve this by explicitly specifying the types of the variables involved in the factory call.

data.name: IGrammarSymbolUpcastSuppressor_Justification
data.value: Cast to IGrammarSymbol is not unnecessary, since removing it would cause the production factory generator to emit a different overload.
